arxiv-2007-10919.title: Radiation Damage Study of SensL J-Series Silicon Photomultipliers Using 101.4 MeV Protons
arxiv-2007-10919.creator: Alexei Ulyanov, David Murphy, Joseph Mangan, Viyas Gupta, Wojciech Hajdas, Daithi de Faoite, Brian Shortt, Lorraine Hanlon, Sheila McBreen
arxiv-2007-10919.description: Abstract Radiation damage of J-series silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs) has been studied in the context of using these photodetectors in future space-borne scintillation detectors. Several SiPM samples were exposed to 101.4 MeV protons, with 1 MeV neutron equivalent fluence ranging from 1.27 × 10 8 1.27\times 10^{8} n eq /cm 2 to 1.23 × 10 10 1.

arxiv-2503-15218.title: Functional Correspondences in the Human and Marmoset Visual Cortex During Movie Watching: Insights from Correlation, Redundancy, and Synergy
arxiv-2503-15218.creator: Qiang Li, Ting Xu, Vince D. Calhoun
arxiv-2503-15218.description: Abstract The world of beauty is deeply connected to the visual cortex, as perception often begins with vision in both humans and marmosets. Quantifying functional correspondences in the visual cortex across species can help us understand how information is processed in the primate visual cortex, while also providing deeper insights into human visual cortex functions through the study of marmosets.

arxiv-2511-17305.title: Efficient calculation of magnetic fields from ferromagnetic materials near strong electromagnets, and application to stellarator coil optimization Journal: Fusion Engineering and Design
arxiv-2511-17305.creator: Matt Landreman, Humberto Torreblanca, Antoine Cerfon
arxiv-2511-17305.description: Abstract In fusion reactor design, steels under consideration for the blanket are ferromagnetic, so the steel’s effect on the plasma physics must be examined. For efficient calculation of these fields, we can exploit the fact that the ferromagnetic material gives a small perturbation relative to the fields from the electromagnetic coils and plasma.

pmc-11488479.title: Pore Network Modeling of Intraparticle Transport Phenomena Accompanied by Chemical Reactions
pmc-11488479.creator: A Fathiganjehlou, E A J F Peters, K A Buist, J A M Kuipers
pmc-11488479.description: In this work, a 3D pore network model (PNM) is introduced for modeling reaction-diffusion phenomena, with and without coupled heat transfer, in a spherical porous catalyst particle. The particle geometry is generated by packing thousands of microspheres inside a large sphere to represent the 3D geometry, porosity, and tortuosity of a spherical catalyst particle.

pmc-12390476.title: AI-Generated Fall Data: Assessing LLMs and Diffusion Model for Wearable Fall Detection
pmc-12390476.creator: Sana Alamgeer, Yasine Souissi, Anne Ngu, Vincenzo Randazzo, Eros Pasero
pmc-12390476.description: Training fall detection systems is challenging due to the scarcity of real-world fall data, particularly from elderly individuals. To address this, we explore the potential of Large Language Models (LLMs) for generating synthetic fall data. This study evaluates text-to-motion (T2M, SATO, and ParCo) and text-to-text models (GPT4o, GPT4, and Gemini) in simulating realistic fall scenarios.

pmc-12528756.title: Impact of preoperative antidepressant use on surgical and functional outcomes of robot assisted radical prostatectomy
pmc-12528756.creator: Linfeng Wang, Qiuchen Li, Rui Sun, Ziling Wei, Gaojie Zhang, Yong Huang, Jiang Yu, Hong Qiao, Qingyu Wu, Jiajia Jin
pmc-12528756.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Compare surgical outcomes of Robot‑Assisted Radical Prostatectomy (RARP) between patients with and without depression. This retrospective study included consecutive patients who underwent RARP at three tertiary hospitals between January 2021 and December 2023. Patients were divided into intervention and control groups based on the presence of a confirmed diagnosis of depression and the use of antidepressants for more than six months.

pmc-12541609.title: Dynamic Changes in Bilirubin Predict 90-Day Mortality in Patients With Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Acute Decompensations of Cirrhosis: The HCC-AD Score

pmc-12596681.creator: Luxwell Jokonya, Aaron Musara, Ignitious Esene, Kantenga Kabulo, Kazadi Kalangu
pmc-12596681.description: Human immunodeficiency virus/acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (HIV/AIDS) is associated with an increased prevalence of some malignancies. pmc-12993286.title: Protocol for identifying surface membrane proteins and their associated proteome from mouse cortical neuron cultures by in situ biotinylation
pmc-12993286.creator: Liang Shi, Pritha Bagchi, GiaLinh N Nguyen, Victor Faundez, Gary J Bassell
pmc-12993286.description: SummaryModifications to the plasma membrane proteome reflect neuronal physiological states. Here, we present a protocol to profile surface proteins from mouse cortical neuron cultures using in situ biotinylation. The workflow includes neuron culture, surface labeling, enrichment of biotinylated proteins, and on-beads digestion followed by mass spectrometry, enabling quantitative and comparative analysis of membrane-associated proteins across diverse physiological conditions.

pmc-13081302.title: A bidimensional early intervention strategy of standard of care in combination with corticosteroids in elderly patients with mild to moderate COVID-19 (BEAT-COV study): a multicentre, open-label, randomized controlled trial
pmc-13081302.creator: Qiaoling Ruan, Yanliang Zhang, Tingting Zhao, Feng Zhu, Xi Liu, Ran Cao, Yongzhong Li, Xiaoqiang Zhang, Wei Song, Jiawei Geng, Deming Zou, Yuanyuan Li, Liaoyun Zhang, Chao Wu, Yuanbo Lan, Xiangchun Ding, Fuli Huang, Jiqin Wu, Feng Sun, Lingyun Shao, Wenhong Zhang

Whether the use of corticosteroids in this population with mild to moderate COVID-19 could prevent disease progression remains controversial.MethodsThe BEAT COV trial assessed corticosteroids treatments in elderly patients with mild to moderate COVID-19.

pmc-13566672.creator: Yusuf Öztürk, Abdullah Enes Ataş, Şeyma Ünüvar, Muhammet Kocabaş
pmc-13566672.description: Background/Objectives: To compare computed tomography (CT)-derived body composition parameters across hormonal subtypes of adrenal adenomas and investigate their associations with hormonal activity. Methods: This retrospective study included 171 patients with unilateral adrenal adenomas categorized as Cushing syndrome (CS), mild autonomous cortisol secretion (MACS), non-functioning adenoma (NFA), or primary aldosteronism (PA).

pmc-13623740.title: Completion of ≥6 cycles of adjuvant temozolomide is the strongest modifiable prognostic factor in glioblastoma: a 17-year real-world cohort of 319 glioma patients from a single Chinese center
pmc-13623740.creator: Pei Liu, Xiaotang Xiao, Beiquan Hu, Kebei Xu, Ting Liu, Xu Liu, Huixian Huang, Qiang Pang, Zhiping Lu, Defeng Qing, Yu Liang, Siting Lin, Hao Chen, Heming Lu
pmc-13623740.description: BackgroundLevel-1 evidence supports adjuvant temozolomide (TMZ) after chemoradiotherapy in newly diagnosed glioblastoma, but many patients discontinue before completing the six cycles the regimen calls for—particularly in China, where long-term outcome data anchored to treatment intensity remain scarce. We quantified the independent prognostic value of completing ≥6 cycles of adjuvant TMZ in a 17-year single-center Chinese glioma cohort.

pmc-13700155.description: BackgroundIdeally, deceased donor kidney transplantation is preferred for patients with mitochondrial nephropathy caused by the m.3243 A > G mutation to avoid genetic risks. However, in regions where deceased donation is limited and living donation predominates, such as Japan, family members are often the only available donors.

uslaw-usc-t7-s5622.title: 7 U.S.C. § 5622 — Export credit guarantee program
uslaw-usc-t7-s5622.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s5622.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 87 (Export Promotion); Subchapter II (Agricultural Export Programs); Part A (Programs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Short-term credit guarantees The Commodity Credit Corporation may guarantee the repayment of credit made available to finance commercial export sales of agricultural commodities, including processed agricultural products and high-value agricultural products, from privately owned stocks on credit terms.
